title: Irrationality of Li₂(1/2)
summary: A Lean formalization of the irrationality of Li₂(1/2) = Σ_{n≥1} 2^(-n)/n². The proof is inspired by A. Fauzan's work on the irrationality of ζ(5) and builds on Moritz Firsching's Lean formalization in mo271/Zeta5. The central idea is to establish the irrationality of a real number r by constructing a sequence of integer polynomials P_n whose values P_n(r) decay rapidly as n tends to infinity, while for every rational q, P_n(q) ≠ 0 for infinitely many n.
